Vaidya’s critical study of the Mahābhārata, its date, its sources and its place in Indian history (Bombay, 1905). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Mahabharata A Criticism · C. V. Vaidya · 1905, 230 scanned pages. Published 1905; Chintaman Vinayak Vaidya died 1938; the epic is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
